purpose: Predeclared attempt 2: continue the distilled standalone image encoder on permitted own+CARLA/Roundabout fit data with the same own-fit-only teacher coordinate system.
hypothesis: Adding verified cross-view foreign fit data to the teacher-distilled core improves generalization over own-only distillation without requiring a second network at inference.

architecture.backbone: torchvision MobileNetV3-Small features, ImageNet-1K V1 initialization, all feature layers trainable in stage 2
architecture.own_mechanism: one 256-dimensional global branch and two independently projected 128-dimensional horizontal stripe branches, concatenated and L2-normalized
architecture.input: float32 RGB NCHW 0..255, 208x208 bbox crop; 1/255 and ImageNet mean/std applied inside the graph
architecture.inference_dependency: same one CrossViewCore ONNX; teacher, OSNet and whitening are training-only
architecture.weights_provenance: TorchVision MobileNet_V3_Small_Weights.IMAGENET1K_V1; external initialization disclosed, not claimed as our architecture or training data
architecture.license_review: TorchVision code is BSD-3-Clause; TorchVision states pretrained weights can inherit dataset terms. Raw external weights stay local pending final redistribution review.

data.train_source: verified combined_train.npz and aligned combined_crops_208.npy: 7248 own +13328 CARLA/Roundabout rows, own dev100 excluded from 19967 fit rows
data.fit_dev_rule: exclude all 100 previously selected own dev vehicle IDs from training; all remaining own train IDs form fit
data.dev_preprocess: Use the same fixed own crops_208.npy rows for both baseline and new core on dev. The baseline consumes these as float32 RGB 0..255 NCHW through its release preprocessing and release whitening; do not refit whitening on dev.
data.dev_baseline_limitation: The teacher combined_v1 and warm-start checkpoint had historical dev100 model-selection exposure; fit-only whitening excludes direct dev labels from new gradients but dev is not an untouched holdout.
data.evaluation: existing reused val, never used for checkpoint, fusion or threshold selection
data.limitation: The 1110x750 val has been reused in prior experiments. This is a paired comparison on a known split, not an untouched holdout.

training.source_checkpoint_sha256: from attempt_1 training.json selected checkpoint; verify recorded SHA and strict load before any gradient
training.warm_start: strict model_state_dict reload; reset AdamW optimizer because original checkpoint has no optimizer state
training.stage1_trainable: not applicable; all layers trainable from first batch
training.stage2_trainable: all MobileNetV3-Small backbone, heads and 1071-ID classifier
training.sampler: 8 vehicle IDs x 4 frames, cross-camera positives required
training.scheduler: cosine anneal within each stage to eta_min=0.000001

classification_loss.policy: all own fit rows; foreign rows excluded in attempt 2

training.augmentation: fit-only horizontal flip p=0.5 and brightness/contrast 0.9..1.1, same as prior run
training.checkpoint_selection: highest dev cosine full-gallery mAP with market same-camera exclusion after each epoch; ties earlier epoch; val never selects
training.pilot: one real P8K4 batch checks finite losses/gradients/parameter update and nonempty cross-camera pairs; after first epoch RSS<4096MiB and projected total runtime<7200s or STOP with partial evidence

selection.fusion: For weight w in [0.25,0.5,0.75], L2-normalize each 512D branch and concatenate [sqrt(1-w)*release_baseline, sqrt(w)*new_core] into a 1024D research descriptor. Its pairwise cosine is (1-w)*baseline cosine + w*core cosine for Q-Q/Q-G/G-G. Run KR once on these fused descriptors, never average two separately reranked score matrices. Select one w by dev cosine mAP, ties smaller w; reuse w for KR.
selection.baseline_dev: Use the same two release ONNX files, release normalization and lw_ens_j48_rho0.5.npz on dev and val; no fit-only or dev-refit whitening.
selection.threshold: maximize presence F1 on dev precision-recall curve, tie higher threshold; separate for each model and cosine/KR

evaluation.multiplicity: Holm across core/fusion × cosine/KR × 2 predeclared attempts (8 deltas) if both attempts reach validation; missing comparisons marked NOT RUN, never removed after seeing values
evaluation.candidate_acceptance: Release changes only if KR mAP delta >= +0.005 and paired CI95 lower >0, cosine delta >=0, refusal F1 no worse than -0.02 in both modes, and all performance limits pass; otherwise retain d1_j48.
evaluation.export_tolerance: Torch vs ONNX max absolute descriptor difference <=1e-5 on real crops; same top-1 and refusal decisions on all validation rows at dev-frozen thresholds
evaluation.research_target: standalone KR mAP >= 0.7740915539438481 on the reused val is the user goal, not a guaranteed outcome or the separate release gate

benchmark.device: same workstation CPU for release and new ONNX
benchmark.order: paired interleaved baseline/core/fusion with model order reversed every sample
benchmark.boundary: same preprocessed 208x208 float32 tensor to final L2 descriptor; no JPEG decode, API, Qdrant or KR

release_performance_limits.inference_VRAM: NOT APPLICABLE: this fallback training and production paired benchmark are CPU-only; process training RSS must remain below 4096 MiB as specified in pilot
release_performance_limits.gallery_index: 512D standalone raw 750-row float32 index <=1536000 bytes; 1024D research fusion <=3072000 bytes before Qdrant overhead

release: d1_j48 stays untouched and shippable until explicit candidate acceptance; do not alter canonical reproduce metric bounds

teacher.source: fresh ONNX Runtime extraction of both release ONNX on the same hash-checked RGB uint8 208x208 raw crops, NCHW float32 0..255; no network download
teacher.geometry: L2 each raw branch -> L2(A+B) -> discriminative whitening rho=0.5 fitted only on own fit6639 vehicle/camera labels -> L2 512D target
teacher.target_rows: own fit6639 plus permitted foreign 13328 in ascending original row order; exclude own dev609; apply exactly the attempt_1 own-fit-only P,m to all rows; no new whitening fit
teacher.row_order: compare own NPZ image_id/vehicle_id/camera_id to hash-checked train_fit.csv row by row; compare first 7248 combined metadata/raw rows before attempt 2
teacher.historical_exposure: teacher combined_v1 and source checkpoint were previously selected using dev100; fit-only target generation prevents new direct dev leakage, not historical independence

attempt_plan.attempt_1: own-only fit6639 distill warm-start of checkpoint 22fc2fdd; select on dev, freeze ONNX/selection before validation
attempt_plan.attempt_2: combined fit19967 continuation of attempt_1 selected checkpoint for eight full epochs, same fit-only own whitening teacher geometry, own CE only, other losses all fit rows; select on same dev
attempt_plan.attempt_2_resource_gate: start only if combined NPZ/raw match frozen SHA, teacher target generation and one-batch smoke fit RSS<4096MiB and projected runtime before 27.09 00:00 MSK; decide before opening attempt_1 val; no trigger based on val result
attempt_plan.validation: run shared reused val once for each fully selected candidate after both attempts are frozen or attempt_2 resource-blocked; no adaptive retraining after val
